slides.title: Good Prompts, Good Answers
content: A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A great prompt gets a great answer.
slides.narration:
Have you ever got a strange answer from an AI?
That's because of a weak prompt.
A strong prompt gets a smart answer.
Think about it.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon character looking confused at AI response, then happy at good response. Side-by-side comparison.

slides.title: The 3 Key Ingredients
content: Clarity
Context
Constraints
slides.narration:
The best prompts have three parts.
We call them the 3 C's.
They are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Let's explore each one.
slides.image_prompt: Infographic: 3 interlocking circles, labeled Clarity, Context, Constraints. Simple, clean design.

slides.title: 1. Clarity: Be Specific!
content: The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
Vague prompts give generic answers.
slides.narration:
First, let's look at Clarity.
Clarity means being specific.
The AI can't read your mind.
Vague prompts lead to unhelpful answers.
slides.image_prompt: Magnifying glass over the word 'Clarity', with a question mark thought bubble above an AI robot icon.

slides.title: Clarity: Weak Prompt Example
content: Weak Prompt: "Write about electric cars."
slides.narration:
Here's a weak prompt.
"Write about electric cars."
It's too vague.
What will the AI write about?
slides.image_prompt: Text box displaying 'Write about electric cars.' with a large red 'X' over it.

slides.title: Clarity: Good Prompt Example
content: Good Prompt: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Let's make it clear.
This prompt is much better.
It tells the AI exactly what to do.
See the difference?
slides.image_prompt: Text box displaying the improved prompt with a large green checkmark over it.

slides.title: Practice Clarity
content: Turn this weak prompt into a clear one:
Weak: "Tell me about history."
slides.narration:
Now, let's practice.
Look at this weak prompt.
How can you make it specific?
Think about your goal.
slides.image_prompt: Person sitting at a laptop, screen showing 'Tell me about history.' in a text editor. A thought bubble with a question mark.

slides.title: 2. Context: Give Background!
content: Context tells the AI why you're asking.
It helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
slides.narration:
Next, we add Context.
Context gives the AI background information.
It helps the AI understand your purpose.
It takes on the right perspective.
slides.image_prompt: World map icon or a thought bubble showing a specific scenario, representing background information.

slides.title: Context: Good Prompt (from Clarity)
content: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Let's use our good prompt again.
It's clear, but lacks context.
Who is the audience for this post?
slides.image_prompt: Text box with the 'Good Prompt' from slide 9, highlighted to show it needs more.

slides.title: Context: Better Prompt Example
content: Better Prompt: "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Here's the prompt with context.
We added the audience and blog type.
The AI now knows who it's writing for.
This improves the output.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison: previous prompt vs. new prompt with added context highlighted in green.

slides.title: Practice Context
content: Add context to this prompt:
"Write a review of a new smartphone."
slides.narration:
Let's practice adding context.
Think about the audience.
Who will read this review?
Give the AI this background.
slides.image_prompt: Person typing on a keyboard, screen showing 'Write a review of a new smartphone.' A thought bubble with audience icons.

slides.title: 3. Constraints: Set Rules!
content: Constraints set boundaries for the AI.
Tell the AI the length, format, and style.
slides.narration:
Finally, let's add Constraints.
Constraints are rules for the AI.
They define the output's shape.
Tell it the length, format, or style.
slides.image_prompt: Ruler and pencil icon, symbolizing rules and boundaries. A stop sign or boundary line graphic.

slides.title: Constraints: Better Prompt (from Context)
content: "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
We'll use our prompt with context.
It's good, but what about length?
What about the tone?
slides.image_prompt: Text box with the 'Better Prompt' from slide 13, highlighted to show it needs more.

slides.title: Constraints: Excellent Prompt Example
content: Excellent Prompt: "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments."
slides.narration:
This is an excellent prompt.
We added length, tone, and a call to action.
These are specific constraints.
The AI will follow these rules.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison: previous prompt vs. new prompt with added constraints highlighted in blue.

slides.title: Practice Constraints
content: Add constraints to this prompt:
"Write a short story about a robot."
slides.narration:
Now, let's practice constraints.
Think about the story's length.
What kind of style should it have?
Give the AI clear rules.
slides.image_prompt: Person typing on a keyboard, screen showing 'Write a short story about a robot.' A list of constraint options (word count, tone).

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be.
It's a super-powerful trick.
slides.narration:
Here's a bonus tip.
Give the AI a persona.
Tell it who to act as.
This is a very powerful trick.
slides.image_prompt: A chameleon changing colors, symbolizing adopting a persona or role.

slides.title: Persona Example
content: Prompt: "Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food."
slides.narration:
Look at this example.
The AI is an "expert travel agent."
It knows its role and focus.
This leads to a tailored output.
slides.image_prompt: Text box showing the persona prompt with the 'Act as...' part highlighted in yellow.

slides.title: Summary
content: Good prompts use Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Clarity: Be specific.
Context: Give background.
Constraints: Set rules.
Bonus: Use a persona.
slides.narration:
In summary, we learned about the 3 C's.
Clarity means being specific.
Context provides background.
Constraints set the rules.
And you can add a persona.
slides.image_prompt: Infographic summarizing the 3 C's and Persona with icons and short definitions.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Write a prompt using all 3 C's.
Include a persona.
Your prompt should ask for a recipe for a healthy dinner.
Share your prompt with a friend.
slides.narration:
Here's an assignment for you.
Write a prompt using all 3 C's.
Also, add a persona to it.
Ask for a healthy dinner recipe.
Then, try it out!
